        Privacy policy

        Comfeh Crate ("we", "us") runs this website to sell period-care hampers and offer a cycle tracker, games and greeting cards. This policy explains what we collect, why, and the choices you have. We follow India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

        What we collect

        • Account details: your name, email and a securely hashed password (we can never see your password).
        • Order details: what you buy, delivery name, phone number and address, gift notes and delivery dates.
        • Cycle tracker data: period dates, symptoms, moods, notes and reminders you choose to log. This is sensitive health information, so it is encrypted before it is stored and only you can see it.
        • Greeting cards: the cards, photos and voice notes you create, so the person you send the link to can open them.
        • Payments: handled by Razorpay. We never see or store your card, UPI or bank details. We only receive a payment confirmation.
        • Orders on WhatsApp: when you order, the details you choose to send (name, phone, address, items, gift note) reach us through WhatsApp. Payments are made by UPI or bank transfer, and we only see the payment confirmation.
        • On your device only: game progress, scores and calm-corner progress are saved in your browser and are not sent to us. On this site your sign-in, cycle tracker and notes are also saved only on your device. We never see them. Your account, orders, cycle tracker, notes and cards are stored securely in our database (Supabase). Your tracker and notes are private to you.

        How we use it

        • To process, pack and deliver your orders and send order updates.
        • To run your account, the cycle tracker, predictions and reminders.
        • To respond when you contact us.
        • To keep the site secure and prevent fraud.

        We never sell your data, and we never use your cycle data for advertising.

        Who we share it with

        Only the services needed to run the shop: our hosting and database providers (where your data is stored, in encrypted form for tracker data), Razorpay (payments), our email provider (order and password emails), and the courier partner who delivers your crate (name, phone and address only). If the optional chat with Comfy is switched on, the messages you type to Comfy are sent to our AI provider to generate a reply and are not stored by us.

        Cookies

        We use one essential cookie to keep you signed in. We don't use advertising or tracking cookies.

        How long we keep it

        We keep your account and tracker data until you delete your account. We keep order records for as long as Indian tax and accounting laws require.

        Your rights

        You can access, correct or delete your personal data at any time. Delete your account from the account menu (or email us) and we will erase your profile, tracker data and cards. You can also withdraw consent or raise a grievance by writing to our grievance contact at comfehcrate@gmail.com. We reply within 7 working days.

        Age

        Comfeh Crate is meant for people aged 18 and over. If you are under 18, please use the site with a parent or guardian's consent.

        Changes

        If we change this policy we'll update the date above, and tell you by email for any important changes.

        Last updated 8 November 2026

        Terms of use

        By using this website or placing an order, you agree to these terms. Please read them along with our privacy, refund and shipping policies.

        Your account

        Keep your password private. You're responsible for activity on your account. Tell us straight away if you think someone else has accessed it.

        Orders and prices

        • All prices are in Indian Rupees and include applicable taxes unless stated otherwise. Delivery charges are shown before you pay.
        • You place orders by sending us the order message on WhatsApp. An order is confirmed once we've confirmed availability with you and received your payment.An order is confirmed once payment succeeds and you receive a confirmation email. We may cancel an order (with a full refund) if an item is unavailable, the price was shown in error, or we can't deliver to the address.
        • Product designs (teddy colours, hot water bag prints, keychains, lotion scents) in ready-made and surprise crates depend on stock. Photos are for illustration.
        • Subscriptions renew as described on the plan you choose. You can pause or cancel before the next crate is dispatched by emailing us.

        Game rewards

        Discounts earned in the Comfeh arcade apply to orders placed from the same device and account. Rewards have no cash value, can't be combined with other offers unless we say so, and may be changed or withdrawn at any time. Misusing the games to earn rewards may lead to rewards being removed.

        Health information

        The cycle tracker, predictions, comfort tips, stretches and Comfy the care buddy are for general wellbeing and planning only. They are not medical advice, diagnosis or contraception. Always talk to a doctor about severe pain, very heavy bleeding, missed periods or any health concern.

        Greeting cards and content you create

        You're responsible for the messages, photos and voice notes you add to cards. Don't upload anything unlawful, hateful or that you don't have the right to share. Anyone with a card's link can open it, so share links carefully. We may remove content that breaks these rules.

        Our content

        The Comfeh Crate name, logo, designs, games and text belong to us. Product names and brands belong to their owners.

        Liability

        We work hard to keep the site accurate and running, but we provide it "as is". To the extent the law allows, our liability for any order is limited to the amount you paid for it. Nothing here limits your rights under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

        Law

        These terms are governed by the laws of India. Any disputes will be handled by the courts having jurisdiction over our place of business.

        Last updated 8 November 2026

        Refund, return & cancellation policy

        Cancelling an order

        You can cancel any time before your crate is dispatched. Email us with your order number and we'll refund the full amount.

        Returns

        Because our crates contain personal hygiene products, cosmetics and food, we can't accept returns of opened or used items, or returns for change of mind once a crate is delivered.

        Damaged, missing or wrong items

        If anything arrives damaged, leaking, expired, missing or wrong, write to us within 48 hours of delivery with your order number and photos (an unboxing video helps). We'll send a replacement or refund the affected items.

        Subscriptions

        Cancel or pause before your next crate is dispatched and you won't be charged for it. For prepaid 3- and 6-month plans, crates not yet dispatched are refunded on a pro-rata basis.

        How refunds are paid

        Approved refunds go back to the UPI ID or bank account you paid fromyour original payment method within 5–7 working days. Your bank may take a few extra days to show it.

        Last updated 8 November 2026

        Shipping & delivery policy

        • Where we deliver: across India, to any serviceable PIN code.
        • Dispatch: within 1–3 working days of your order being confirmed (after payment on WhatsApp).
        • Delivery time: usually 3–7 working days after dispatch, depending on your location.
        • Delivery charges: ₹79 per order, free on orders over ₹999.
        • Gift dates: if you pick a "deliver on" date, we'll time the dispatch to arrive close to it. Courier delays can happen, so please allow a day or two either side.
        • Subscriptions: each crate is dispatched to arrive about 3 days before your predicted period.
        • Packaging: every crate ships in plain outer packaging, so nobody knows what's inside.
        • Tracking: we'll sendemail your tracking details on WhatsApp when your crate ships.

        If your crate is delayed beyond 10 working days, write to us and we'll chase the courier or arrange a replacement.
